name: Consensus
description: An AI-powered academic search engine allowing developers and AI agents to search over 220 million peer-reviewed papers and retrieve citations and metadata.

evidence.claim: Consensus API lets you integrate research search into applications over a single REST endpoint with self-serve keys.
The Consensus Platform API uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE.
Official Model Context Protocol server exists for connecting AI assistants to Consensus.

notes: Consensus provides both self-serve API keys via their web application and an OAuth 2.0 flow for applications acting on behalf of users. They also offer an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
